title: Faithful flatness is stable under ring base change
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a faithfully flat homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map], and let $R\to R'$ be any homomorphism of commutative rings. Then the base-change map $R'\to R'\otimes_RS$, $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$, is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map]; equivalently, $R'\otimes_RS$, an $R'$-module through the first factor, is a faithfully flat $R'$-module.
